title: Quran Tafsirs based on the Teachings of the Ahlul Bayt
content:
“I am leaving among you two things which, if you will cling to them, you will never go astray: the Book of Allah and my Ahlul Bayt”

Prophet Muhammad (A.S.)

What You Can Find Here

  1. Weekly live online classes designed to help you better understand the Quran followed, by a Q&A. These free classes are conducted by Sheikh Azhar Nasser
  2. Videos of English Quran Tafsirs by scholars across the globe

Live Classes + Q&A

We’re currently conducting an in depth study on the life of Prophet Muhammad. Click here to sign up for email notifications of upcoming classes.

Classes are conducted every Wednesday at 6:30pm PST. Subscribe below to get the link to each live class emailed to you.

Past classes for the current series can be viewed below

Quran Tafsirs

Previously we covered the following surahs:

  • Surah An’aam (#6)
  • Surah Tawbah (#9)
  • Surah Al-Anbiya (#21)
  • Surah Ar-Rum (#30)
  • Surah Fatir (#35)
  • Surah Hujurat (#49)
  • Surah Najam (#53)

Other scholars offering Quran tafsirs of the include Sheikh Bahmanpour, Sayyid Muhammad Rizvi, Sheikh Murtaza Alidina, H.I. Abbas Ayleya, Sheikh Jaffer H. Jaffer and more.

Their tafirs and the tafsirs of various other scholars can be found here.

How Can You Help?

If you know of any scholars who offer English Quran tafsirs but their lectures have not been included, please let me know by sending an email to admin at why-quran.org
